notes: LibreHardwareMonitor can now start at boot, elevated, from inside HeatWatch.
patch_notes: New: a 'Set up LHM to start at boot…' button in Settings opens a guided one-time setup that registers LibreHardwareMonitor in Task Scheduler to start elevated at every sign-in, so HeatWatch always has CPU temperatures — one admin approval, removable any time from the same dialog. The Settings card also shows whether autostart is on or off. New test rounds 20 and 21 cover the task registration and the dialog; all 21 rounds pass.
